title: Thandege Thakka Maga
desc: Sathya is forced to marry a woman from a lower caste after his father's sudden death. He struggles to lead a happy marital life while dealing with certain problems.

title: Malgudi Days
desc: After announcing his retirement, Malgudi, a famous writer, goes back to the town where he spent his childhood. On the way, he meets a woman, and the two share their life stories with one another.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Jeevanadhi
desc: After several years of marriage, a couple becomes parents. However, after a childless couple finds their infant boy, they take him away and try to raise him as their own son.

title: Appana Preethiyalli
desc: While on his deathbed, a businessman tells his family about a cunning man who stole most of his wealth. Hearing his father's revelation, the youngest son lays out a plan to seek revenge.
